They can sell now. But owners of Bitcoin ETFs have to watch helplessly until Monday morning to sell and salvage what's left.

2121770407221166239.en_summary: Jensen Huang’s two children both work at Nvidia, per The Information. Madison Huang, a senior director in Nvidia’s Omniverse simulation group, earned more than $1 million in 2024. She trained at the Culinary Institute of America and Le Cordon Bleu and worked at LVMH before joining. Spencer Huang, a product manager in robotics earning an estimated $530,000, ran a cocktail bar in Taiwan before getting his MBA at NYU Stern. Huang has defended it, saying many employees’ children work at Nvidia and that parents “wouldn’t recommend their children if they were unqualified.”
2121770407221166239.zh_summary: 據The Information，黃仁勳的兩個孩子都在Nvidia工作。Madison Huang，Nvidia Omniverse模擬小組的高級總監，2024年收入超過100萬美元。她在美國煮飪學院和Le Cordon Bleu受訓，加入前在LVMH工作。Spencer Huang，機器人產品經理，估計收入53萬美元，在台灣經營雞尾酒吧後在NYU Stern獲得MBA。黃仁勳為之辯護，說許多員工的孩子在Nvidia工作，父母「如果他們不合格就不會推薦孩子」。
